products.name: Moomoo Cash Plus
catch: The headline rate only applies to the first RM50,000; balances above earn 3.20%.
Returns come from money-market funds, so this is not PIDM protected and the rate moves with the market.
Promotional boosts can end without notice.
products.concept: Your idle cash sits in money-market funds that earn daily interest, and you can sell back to cash within about a day.

products.name: StashAway Simple
catch: Rate is variable and tied to underlying fund yields, not guaranteed.
Balances above RM100,000 earn a lower 2.80%.
products.concept: A robo-advisor invests your cash in low-risk funds for you, so you earn more than a normal savings account without picking anything.

products.name: GXBank Savings
catch: The 4.50% bonus rate is capped at RM5,000; the rest earns 2.10%.
Bonus tier needs a minimum number of monthly transactions or card spends to stay active.
Bonus rate is promotional and can be reduced.
products.concept: A digital bank pays a bonus rate on a small balance, then a normal rate above it, so your real rate is a blend of both.

cond.text: Bonus rate needs a minimum number of monthly transactions or card spends

products.name: Versa Cash
catch: Not PIDM protected; returns are fund performance, not a promise.
Withdrawals take one business day, so it is not for same-day cash needs.
products.concept: A money market fund lends your cash out for very short periods and shares the interest with you.

products.name: ASNB Fixed-Price Fund
catch: Bumi quota: open to Bumiputera investors only; non-Bumiputera applicants cannot invest.
Holding cap of RM200,000; amounts above earn nothing.
Dividends are declared once a year and are not guaranteed.
products.concept: A government-linked fund that pays an annual dividend; the price stays fixed, so you earn through dividends, not price growth.

products.name: Maybank eFD
catch: Breaking the deposit early forfeits the interest.
Auto-renewal: if you do nothing, it rolls into a new term at that day's board rate.
products.concept: A fixed deposit locks your money for a set time in return for a guaranteed rate and full PIDM protection.
